question: In answer to my question E-002667/20241, the Commission stated that Eurostat was working to quantify the administrative burden to provide a baseline for its reduction targets of 25 % for businesses and 35 % for SMEs. Subsequently, in its Communication COM(2025)0047, the Commission estimated that this burden carries an annual cost of EUR 150 billion, setting a savings target of EUR 37.5 billion by 2029.
Furthermore, in June 2026, the Commission announced that its simplification initiatives would generate an estimated annual administrative saving of EUR 18 billion.2 In light of the above: 1.
Does the Commission consider the EUR 150 billion estimate to be the definitive baseline for calculating the 25 % target?
Has it already quantified the administrative costs borne by SMEs to provide a specific baseline for the 35 % target and if so, what is this figure?
Distinguishing between savings that have genuinely materialised and those that are merely projected or remain to be implemented, what percentage of both targets has actually been met so far?
